startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty = today. PVPC is available since 2021-06-01 and the spot market since 2014-04-01.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty = the start date, or tomorrow when both dates are empty and 'Include tomorrow' is on.

includeTomorrow.title: Include tomorrow
includeTomorrow.description: With no dates, also return tomorrow's prices. The spot market is published around 13:00 and PVPC around 20:30 (Spanish time); until then tomorrow's PVPC fields are empty.

output.title: Output
enumTitles: One row per day (averages, min, max, cheapest hours and windows)
output.description: One row per hour, or one row per day with averages, minimum, maximum, cheapest hours and cheapest 2, 3 and 4-hour windows.

cheapestHoursPerDay.title: Only the N cheapest hours of each day
cheapestHoursPerDay.description: Hourly output only. E.g. 4 returns the 4 cheapest hours of each day: perfect to schedule a heat pump, an EV charger or a washing machine. 0 = all hours.

tariffPeriods.title: Tariff periods (2.0TD)
tariffPeriods.description: Hourly output only. Keep only these periods.

includeSpotQuarterHours.title: Include 15-minute spot prices
includeSpotQuarterHours.description: Since October 2025 the day-ahead market has 15-minute prices. Adds the four quarter-hour prices of each hour.
